description: This is an integration test class for the ReplayedTransactionBusinessEventService, specifically testing its behavior with different transaction change scenarios in the loan account context. It uses JUnit 5 and Mockito for mocking dependencies and verifying interactions.

classes.name: ReplayedTransactionBusinessEventServiceIntegrationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ReplayedTransactionBusinessEventService, testing replays of transaction events with different scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the service under test with mocked dependencies before each test.

methods.name: testWhenParamIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that no event notifications are triggered when the input transaction detail parameter is null.

methods.name: testWhenParamHasNoMapping
methods.description: Verifies that no events are fired when the transaction detail has no associated mappings.

methods.name: testWhenParamHasOneNewTransaction
methods.description: Ensures the service correctly initiates event recording and dispatches an event when a single new transaction change is present.

methods.name: testWhenParamHasTwoNewTransaction
methods.description: Checks that the service handles multiple transaction changes by triggering multiple event notifications accordingly.

methods.name: testWhenParamHasError
methods.description: Tests the error handling when the notification service throws an exception during event notification.
